name: Cyrus Therepentous
summary: At Slither Rock, Cyrus Therepentous puts mortals who enter his lair to the test. He seeks survivors strong enough to serve the Black dragonflight.

sections.title: The Master of Slither Rock
sections.body: From his cavern at Slither Rock, Cyrus Therepentous watches the volcanic crags of the Burning Steppes. He scorns mortal travelers and calls anyone who disturbs his lair a fool. Yet he does not strike every trespasser down. Instead, he sends his minions against them in a deadly trial. Those who survive the flames may prove useful to the Black dragonflight.

faq.answer: Cyrus Therepentous is an intelligent black dragonspawn who serves the Black dragonflight. He tests mortals who enter his cave at Slither Rock in the Burning Steppes.

faq.q: Where can Cyrus Therepentous be found?
faq.answer: Cyrus Therepentous dwells deep in a cave at Slither Rock, in the northeastern Burning Steppes.

faq.q: Why doesn't Cyrus attack adventurers on sight?
faq.answer: Cyrus Therepentous considers eating trespassers, but first tests whether they might prove useful. He pits them against deadly trials and his minions, sparing those who prove their worth.
